chapter_title_en: The Dice Swallows the Dragon Vein
chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 575: The Dice Swallows the Dragon Vein & Holds Great Liang Hostage
chapter_meta_description: The Zuowandao Dice eats the Great Liang Dragon Vein, holds a dynasty hostage inside Gao Zhijian's body. Bai Lingmiao returns with White Lotus power. The Supervisor arrives too late.
og_title: The Dice Just Ate an Empire's Immortal Foundation
og_description: Zuowandao's ultimate power play: swallow the Dragon Vein, become untouchable. Li Huowang can't fight—he's holding his friend's corpse.
twitter_title: The Dice Wins This Round: Dragon Vein Devoured
twitter_description: The Zuowandao's "use your brain" philosophy pays off as the Dice consumes Great Liang's fate and vanishes. A brutal checkmate for Li Huowang.

lore_anchors.definition: In Chinese geomancy and political cosmology, the underground energy channel that determines a dynasty's legitimacy; in this novel, it is a literal chain of corpse-emperors that can be consumed.
A corrupted spirit-possession ritual where White Lotus disciples use self-mutilation to summon a god into a target's body, temporarily controlling them.
A term from the Dao De Jing referring to the mysterious, generative female principle of the Dao; used as the Supervisor's name, implying cosmic-level exorcism authority.
A high-ranking Zuowandao member who uses "truth-lies" and now possesses Gao Zhijian's body after consuming the Dragon Vein; his power is both physical and political.
